diagnosis: When the launched leader exited before publishing readiness, unbounded communicate() waited for inherited stdout/stderr pipes to close; a live descendant kept them open, delaying finally cleanup. The readiness loop now rechecks the atomic marker after observing leader exit, uses a 50ms bounded output drain, and reaches identity-checked cleanup. It captures descendants after readiness as well; the test fixture keeps its leader alive briefly after publishing the child PID so cleanup identity capture is deterministic.
